breaking.change: A document's rule no longer reaches a component instance. A rule whose subject names one (#Mine, .loud, Badge, [data-tone] on <Badge id="Mine" class="loud"/>) is refused when the document is parsed; a rule that only sweeps over one (*, #Root > *) passes it by.
breaking.fix: Pass a prop, set a custom property on the instance (<Badge --width="66px"/>), or dress a part the component declares from the style pack ([part="Badge.frame"]).

added.summary: Style props, as in Svelte: --name="value" or --name={expr} on a component instance is a custom property its root inherits, so the component's own rules win, null sets nothing, and a component whose root is another component hands it on. style:--name stays the element's spelling; each is refused on the other with the right one named.
